title: Page 64
transc:
SH Beckwith (2)  Wash 130 pm May 3d 1864
Harriet Belly ---- Lawn has received over Clarke Davis
wagons Downing or Edwards Medical wagons & over Allen
Douglas Tucker Ambulances ---- It was decided at Ann
apple is that Caldwell Smith waggons would be enough
for his Saint then es time ated at Norris
Dayton Seward summer ---- He now asks that Prentiss
Caldwell more wagons teams and drivers completely tabled be
sent to him by Walpole by wedlock noon Yacht
This Queenly can furnish them but they cannot be
spared without injury to the service here shall they
be sent Wiley Burglar


Capt Sam 3rd (1)  Wash'n May 3rd 1864 4 P. M
Growl May Perfume Julia For Palsy Robert All
in chief Vinton Dragon Unity Jupiter has decided
to leave Shelter Smith Polka with that of
Locust on Berlin zebra Miller wishes supplies sent
to Camden up the Washita Windsor zodiac can
you not arrange to have this done Pekin
the Whimpers being protected by Shannons Yoke Jordan
